name: @edu-service/db
description: PostgreSQL persistence for Edu Service (Prisma schema, migrations, repositories)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @edu-service/feature-flags build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/core build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/financial build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/patron build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/util build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/ai build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/email build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/sms build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/notifications build && pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @edu-service/core build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/financial build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/patron build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/util build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/ai build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/email build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/sms build && pnpm --filter @edu-service/notifications build && pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json
